data.title: Income tax assessment 2024 – refund of €767
data.summary: Finanzamt Beispielhausen issued the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2024 on 27 October 2025. It results in a refund of €767.00, to be paid out to the known bank account.
data.explanation: This is your tax assessment for 2024. Income tax of €7,012.00 was set, but €7,779.00 in wage tax was already withheld, so you get €767.00 back. The money should be paid to your known account in the next few days. Check that the figures match your tax return. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or electronically, or record it at the tax office; the app shows until when. If you agree, nothing else is required.
data.tax_note: Income tax assessment for 2024; keep it as proof of the refund and of your assessed income.
